name: web-made-llms
title: The Web made LLMs possible, and only half of it
html:
The Web made LLMs possible, and only half of it

Links everywhere

The Web’s architecture made every page reachable from another. A crawler needs no map.

A corpus

Filtered Common Crawl was the largest share of GPT-3’s training mix.

The missing half

Crawlers read. They never send a form, so the Web’s transactions were never learned from.

The transactional half of the Web is where agents now have to work.
say: Brief. The same architecture made a crawlable corpus. Filtered Common Crawl was the largest share of GPT-3's training mix. But crawlers only read: they follow links, they never submit forms. The transactional half of the Web was never in the corpus.

sources.label: Brown et al., Language Models are Few-Shot Learners (GPT-3), Table 2.2
